event.title: Senegal Hosts Youth Olympics, First Olympic Event in Africa
event.canonical_title: Senegal Hosts Youth Olympics, First Olympic Event in Africa
event.summary: The Youth Olympic Games have officially opened in Dakar, Senegal, marking the first Olympic event held on the African continent in over 130 years. The event was inaugurated by Senegal's president and features 136 local athletes, supported by 6,000 volunteers.
